literal: The next day the chancellor's Western Pavilion Libationer Lu Sidao said to Xi, "Yesterday when you were summoned your face was already flushed — are the fish and birds not to blame for giving offense?"
idiomatic: Next day Lu Sidao, libationer of the chancellor's Western Pavilion, said to Xi, "When you were summoned yesterday your face was already flushed — surely the fish and birds are not to blame for the offense?"

literal: " Xi smiled slowly and said, "Last night I was quite at ease; I was rather reproached for wine. You gentlemen too are among the things that detain one — surely not only fish and birds."
idiomatic: " Xi smiled slowly. "Last night I was quite at ease, and got a fair scolding over wine. You lot are detainments too — not fish and birds alone."

literal: " When Jinyang fell in defeat, he fled northeast with comrades to escape Zhou troops.
idiomatic: " When Jinyang fell, he fled northeast with his comrades before the Zhou army.

literal: The mountain road was dangerous and remote; they feared local bandits, yet Xi warmed his wine and applied salve without once discontinuing.
idiomatic: The mountain road was treacherous and far; they feared bandits, yet Xi warmed his wine and took his salves without ever missing a day.

literal: Time and again he would not consent to leave; his fellow travelers reproached him. He said, "Do not reproach me. Had my conduct been such that I did not regret it, I would long ago have been one of the Three Excellencies."
idiomatic: Again and again he would not hurry on; his companions blamed him. He said, "Do not blame me. Had I not regretted my own ways, I would long since have been one of the Three Excellencies."

literal: The complete text was collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
idiomatic: The full text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
